snippet.title: SATED - Official Gameplay Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for SATED, an action roguelike simulation game developed by Forest Reges. Players will engage with a cursed fridge that beckons those who dare. Spin the wheel and choose revolting ingredients in this rogue-like-inspired cooking course from the very depths of hell. Leave your customers satisfied or become the meal yourself. SATED is coming soon to Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
